# session.v4 §2 — every line the hook may render, byte for byte.
#
# Format: <case>\t<origin>\t<the exact line>.  A `-` in place of the line means
# the hook renders nothing for that case.  Comment lines start with `#`.
#
# <origin> is `contract` when the line appears verbatim in
# contracts/session.v4.md §2, and `derived` when §2 states the composition
# rule ("topics named only when more than zero", singular/plural) but does not
# spell that combination out. conformance/session/inject/run.py checks every
# `contract` line against the locked file and reports the `derived` ones as
# derived — it never claims the contract says something it does not.
#
# The wording of the two derived lines is the ratified work item's
# (amplifier_bundle_memory-22v, 2026-09-06 20:55): "`1 memory loaded.`
# (singular; with topics `1 memory loaded, 2 topics. /memory to see them.`)".
#
# These are the exact bytes the hook renders. tests/test_inject.py compares each
# `announce_line()` result against the row below.
plural	contract	3 memories loaded. /memory to see them.
plural_with_topics	contract	3 memories loaded, 2 topics. /memory to see them.
singular	contract	1 memory loaded.
singular_with_topics	derived	1 memory loaded, 2 topics. /memory to see them.
empty	contract	no memories yet. Tell me a standing preference — "never use tabs in YAML" — and I'll keep it in every session on this device.
compacted	contract	context compacted. 3 memories still loaded.
compacted_singular	derived	context compacted. 1 memory still loaded.
compacted_empty	derived	-

# session.v4 §2, as amended by v4: "When the session's instance (§12) is not the
# default one, the line names it — `3 memories loaded from ~/.amplifier-agent/memory.
# /memory to see them.` — so a human never has to guess which store answered."  The
# path below is §2's own example, so `named_instance` is checked against the locked
# file like any other `contract` row; the other three are that line's rule applied to
# the combinations §2 does not spell out, and are reported as derived.
#
# The DEFAULT instance is never named, which is why every row above stays exactly as
# it was: those are what a session with no `home:` in its mount plan still renders.
named_instance	contract	3 memories loaded from ~/.amplifier-agent/memory. /memory to see them.
named_instance_with_topics	derived	3 memories loaded from ~/.amplifier-agent/memory, 2 topics. /memory to see them.
named_instance_singular	derived	1 memory loaded from ~/.amplifier-agent/memory.
named_instance_compacted	derived	context compacted. 3 memories still loaded from ~/.amplifier-agent/memory.
